title: Build LLM Artifacts
description: Generates LLM/MCP-compatible artifacts (llms.txt, llms-full.txt, docs-index.json) from documentation content.

docsDir.description: Source docs directory (relative to workspace root). Defaults to `.docs`.

outputDir.description: Output directory for LLM artifacts (relative to workspace root). Defaults to `.generated/llm`.

projectTitle.description: Project title used as heading in generated LLM documents.

projectDescription.description: One-line project description used in the LLM index header.
